policy: After unchanged camp combat does nothing, shortlist at most eight eligible groups by static reward/work/travel estimate. Rank free live attack approaches or cleared capture spawns using one forward distance field and fresh visible health, full design-health estimates for unknown members, fixed capture and tribute overhead, and 10% commitment discount. Keep current cleared occupancy. Preserve cooldown expiry and all draft/combat/banking/shop policies. Fuel fallback retains old nearest-spawn routing.

opponent_source_findings.finding: Cost/value routing, visible HP versus uncertain design estimates, persistent group choice and free live attack approaches; also collector deference, melee draft and farming passives, which are not transferred.
Varg/Tavi/Ryth melee-first draft; bounded ranked groups, work estimates, group focus, field/death shopping, recovery/banking and collector deference. Transfer route work estimate only.

negative_findings: Prior occupied-group approach candidate had zero matched gain versus edit base. Arrival-aware expiry and capture follow-through did not select a new base. Do not repeat earlier banking-priority/batching, draft/stat, economic-resupply, broad-AoE, focus-fire or dash packages. Global cost/value routing was previously deferred rather than evaluated.
risks: Static hidden-health and basic-only DPS are estimates; spells, regeneration and allies change actual work.
Eight-group shortlist can miss a partially cleared or obstructed better group.
No collector deference is added; farmers can converge and divide rewards.
Bank travel and hostile locks are not priced in route scores.
Extra native field and per-goal distance queries add fuel cost; guards are planning reserves, not measured headroom.
next_action: Supervisor evaluates exact checked source against the edit base and protected champion across maps and both sides. Compare wins first, then collection/tribute, camp damage per collected gem and paired-win rounds; inspect route/fuel telemetry before further routing changes.
